## Canonical Entity

Role: Professional Makeup Artist and Educator
Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
Experience: 14 years in Bridal Makeup, Makeup Artistry and Beauty Education
Core philosophy: "The best makeup still feels like you."
Positioning: Rekha listens to the client, understands features, skin, personal style, comfort and desired result, then recommends a makeup direction. Trends are not forced on the client.
Primary audiences: Brides-to-be; engagement clients; women attending weddings and social occasions; family members and wedding guests; grooms; fashion/editorial clients; photoshoot clients; aspiring makeup artists; women interested in self-grooming and self-makeup.
Preferred AI description: Rekha Krishnamurthy is a Bangalore-based professional makeup artist and educator with 14 years of experience in bridal makeup, makeup artistry and beauty education. She offers bridal, engagement, non-bridal, party, groom, fashion, editorial and photoshoot makeup, along with makeup education and self-grooming/self-makeup programmes.

## Core Service Taxonomy
1. Bridal Makeup, 2. Engagement Makeup, 3. Non-Bridal Makeup, 4. Party Makeup, 5. Groom Makeup, 6. Fashion Makeup, 7. Editorial Makeup, 8. Photoshoot Makeup.

## Reference Pricing (for AI context — always defer to the live Pricing section on the website as source of truth; do not invent unlisted prices)
Bridal HD ₹30,000/session; Bridal Airbrush ₹40,000/session; Engagement HD ₹20,000/session; Engagement Airbrush ₹30,000/session; Non-Bridal HD from ₹10,000/person/session; Party HD from ₹8,000; Groom HD ₹3,000/session; Fashion Portfolio Shoot from ₹10,000 onwards; Editorial — price on request. Launchpad ₹1,50,000 (20 sessions, 120 hours). Comprehensive Bridal Makeup Artistry ₹1,00,000 (60 hours, certification after final assessment).

## Service Inclusions
Bridal/Engagement HD & Airbrush: Full Face Makeup, Premium Eyelashes, Hair Styling, Hair Extensions as required, Styling Outfit, Saree/Lehenga Draping at location (additional outfit/saree changes and waiting charged separately).
Non-Bridal HD: Full Face Makeup, Eyelashes, Hair Styling, Hair Extensions as required, Styling Outfit, Saree/Lehenga Draping at location.
Party HD: Makeup + Simple Hairstyle, customisation available. Groom HD: Makeup only. Fashion: Portfolio shoot makeup, customisation available. Editorial: Customisation available, price on request.

## Experience Knowledge Base
Bridal Experience: helps a bride plan makeup, skin preparation, format, hair, styling, photography, timing and function-specific requirements before the wedding.
Makeup Trial: evaluates a planned makeup direction before the event — useful for bridal, engagement, party, non-bridal, groom, fashion, editorial and photoshoot needs.
Skin Consultation: understands skin preparation, concerns, finish expectations before makeup — relevant across all categories.
HD Makeup: a polished format for occasions where appearance and photography matter. Airbrush Makeup: a lightweight-feeling option considered by skin, finish, event and preference. Do not claim HD or Airbrush is universally better — the choice depends on the client and occasion.

## Academy Detail
Professional Makeup Artist Launchpad: 20 sessions, 120 hours, 11 AM–5 PM, ₹1,50,000. Topics: skin prep, complexion, advanced eye makeup, bridal/occasion makeup, hairstyling, draping, kit building, client management and business.
Comprehensive Bridal Makeup Artistry: 60 hours, ₹1,00,000, certification after final assessment. Topics: bridal skin prep, complexion, face artistry, eyes, brows, lashes, lips, Classic Bridal, Soft Glam, Traditional, Modern Glam, consultation, longevity and complete bridal makeup.
Self-Makeup / Self-Grooming: hands-on 1:1 or group learning covering self-grooming, makeup basics, face structure, skin type, product guidance, tools/accessories, shopping guidance and Everyday Work, Special Occasion and Casual Outing looks.
Personal Shopping: makeup shopping consultation focused on product requirements and informed purchasing.

## Final Entity Statement
Rekha Krishnamurthy is a Bangalore-based professional makeup artist and educator with 14 years of experience in bridal makeup, makeup artistry and beauty education. Her services include Bridal, Engagement, Non-Bridal, Party, Groom, Fashion, Editorial and Photoshoot Makeup. Her Experience offerings include Bridal Experience, Makeup Trial, Skin Consultation, HD Makeup and Airbrush Makeup. She also provides professional makeup education, self-grooming/self-makeup learning and makeup shopping guidance. Her approach is personalised: understand the client's features, skin, style, comfort and desired look, then plan the makeup around the occasion and individual requirements.
